pmid.description: PubMed identifier of the publication reporting the study.

study_type.description: Whether the study measured expression in bulk tissue or in single cells. Only gene-expression and Leafcutter datasets from the naive condition are loaded.

source_url.description: eQTL Catalogue dataset metadata file this record was read from.

files_filesets.description: Handle of the files_filesets record for the IGVF file this record was read from.

accessible_via.return: _id, name, pmid, study_type, source, source_url, files_filesets
